note: Literature reports childhood-onset SNUPN cases presenting with proximal weakness whereas adult-onset cases present with proximo-distal and axial weakness mimicking IBM.

evidence.text: Two siblings with adult-onset SNUPN-related muscular dystrophy presented with proximo-distal and axial muscle weakness, early respiratory impairment, and clinical features resembling inclusion body myositis (IBM).

source.title: SNUPN‐Related Muscular Dystrophy: Novel Phenotypic, Pathological and Functional Protein Insights
source.quote: Two siblings carrying two novel deleterious variants in the SNUPN gene (p.Arg27Cys and p.Cys174Tyr) showed adult-onset proximo-distal and axial muscle weakness with early respiratory involvement.

evidence.text: Earlier cohorts of patients with biallelic SNUPN variants presented with classic limb-girdle muscular dystrophy characterized by proximal muscle weakness starting in childhood.

source.title: Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause a limb girdle muscular dystrophy with myofibrillar-like features
source.quote: SNUPN patients show a similar phenotype characterized by proximal weakness starting in childhood, restrictive respiratory dysfunction and prominent contractures
